raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
### What does this PR do?

`logprobs_from_logits_v2` is the fallback used by `logprobs_from_logits` when the flash-attn cross-entropy kernel is not used (not installed, or `VERL_DISABLE_FLASH_ATTN_CE=1` for bitwise-reproducible log-probs). For 16-bit logits it loops over the first dimension. With remove-padding the logits are 2-D `(num_tokens, vocab)`, so this is one `log_softmax` + one `gather` + one autograd node **per token**: thousands of tiny kernels per micro-batch, in the log-prob pass and in the actor update.

For 2-D 16-bit logits this PR processes rows in chunks whose `log_softmax` output is at most `_LOGPROB_CHUNK_BYTES` = 32 MiB (`32 MiB // (vocab * element_size)` rows, e.g. 110 rows for a 151936 vocab in bf16). `split()` is used so the backward stays a single node. Other ranks and fp32/fp64 are unchanged. A labels/logits shape mismatch raises a clear `ValueError`.

### Checklist Before Starting

- [x] Search for similar PRs: https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=logprobs_from_logits_v2 (#3852 replaces the function with a compiled implementation and is a separate, broader change)
- [x] Format the PR title as `[{modules}] {type}: {description}`

### Test

New tests in `tests/utils/test_torch_functional.py`:
- `test_logprobs_from_logits_v2_2d_bitwise_matches_per_row`: bf16 and fp16, contiguous and non-contiguous (transposed) logits, one chunk / uneven chunks / one row per chunk / 151936 vocab. Outputs and gradients are compared to the per-row reference as raw bits (`view(torch.int16)`), 16 cases.
- `test_logprobs_from_logits_v2_bf16_2d_does_not_loop_over_tokens`: 64 tokens run a single `log_softmax` on the whole `(64, 1000)` block.

On one GB300 GPU (CUDA, torch 2.15 nightly):

```
upstream main + new tests:  17 failed  (64 per-row log_softmax calls instead of 1; chunk budget absent)
this PR:                    17 passed
```

Bitwise equality is verified for these dtypes, layouts and this GPU/torch build; it is not a general PyTorch guarantee for other backends.

Benchmark of `logprobs_from_logits_v2` on one GB300 GPU, bf16, median of 5. "Peak" is the extra allocated memory during the call on top of the logits.

| tokens x vocab | path | no_grad forward | peak (no_grad) | forward + backward | peak (fwd+bwd) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 4096 x 151936 | per-row (main) | 125.3 ms | +2.3 MiB | 289.2 ms | +2375 MiB |
| | this PR | 1.3 ms | +31.9 MiB | 3.6 ms | +2374 MiB |
| 16384 x 151936 | per-row (main) | 519.6 ms | +8.3 MiB | 1455.0 ms | +9500 MiB |
| | this PR | 5.1 ms | +31.9 MiB | 14.8 ms | +9496 MiB |
| 16384 x 32000 | per-row (main) | 480.7 ms | +8.1 MiB | 1341.8 ms | +2000 MiB |
| | this PR | 1.2 ms | +32.0 MiB | 2.9 ms | +2000 MiB |

The chunked path holds one chunk's `log_softmax` output (bounded by the 32 MiB budget) where the per-row loop held about one row, so the no-grad peak rises by up to ~32 MiB; with gradients the peak is unchanged. Budget sweep for 16384 x 151936 (no_grad / fwd+bwd): 8 MiB 19.5 / 49.6 ms, 32 MiB 5.1 / 14.8 ms, 64 MiB 4.3 / 11.0 ms, 512 MiB 3.3 / 9.1 ms; 32 MiB keeps nearly all of the speedup.

### Design & Code Changes

- `verl/utils/torch_functional.py`: `_LOGPROB_CHUNK_BYTES = 1 << 25`; chunked branch for 2-D logits in the 16-bit path.

### Checklist Before Submitting

- [x] Read the [Contribute Guide](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [x] Apply pre-commit checks (ruff 0.12.2 check / format on the changed files).
- [ ] Add / Update the documentation. (Not needed.)
- [x] Add unit or end-to-end test(s) to the CI workflow (added to the existing `tests/utils/test_torch_functional.py`).

@@ -18,13 +18,16 @@
 import torch
 import torch.distributed as dist
 import torch.multiprocessing as mp
+import torch.nn.functional as F
 
+from verl.utils import torch_functional
 from verl.utils.device import get_device_name, get_nccl_backend, get_torch_device
 from verl.utils.torch_functional import (
     calculate_sum_pi_squared_from_logits,
     distributed_masked_mean,
     distributed_mean_max_min_std,
     expand_as_nested,
+    logprobs_from_logits_v2,
     masked_mean,
 )
 
@@ -178,3 +181,56 @@ def test_expand_as_nested():
 
     with pytest.raises(AssertionError):
         expand_as_nested(tensor, nested_tensor.unsqueeze(-1))
+
+
+def _per_row_logprobs(logits, labels):
+    rows = [F.log_softmax(row, dim=-1)[label] for row, label in zip(logits, labels, strict=True)]
+    return torch.stack(rows)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("dtype", [torch.bfloat16, torch.float16], ids=["bf16", "fp16"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("transposed", [False, True], ids=["contiguous", "non-contiguous"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "num_tokens,vocab_size,chunk_bytes",
+    [(37, 1000, 1 << 26), (37, 1000, 8192), (37, 1000, 1), (5, 151936, 1 << 20)],
+    ids=["one-chunk", "uneven-chunks", "one-row-per-chunk", "large-vocab"],
+)
+def test_logprobs_from_logits_v2_2d_bitwise_matches_per_row(
+    monkeypatch, num_tokens, vocab_size, chunk_bytes, transposed, dtype
+):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(torch_functional, "_LOGPROB_CHUNK_BYTES", chunk_bytes)
+    device = get_device_name()
+    generator = torch.Generator().manual_seed(0)
+    shape = (vocab_size, num_tokens) if transposed else (num_tokens, vocab_size)
+    base = (torch.randn(shape, generator=generator) * 4).to(dtype).to(device)
+    labels = torch.randint(0, vocab_size, (num_tokens,), generator=generator).to(device)
+    grad_out = torch.randn(num_tokens, generator=generator).to(dtype).to(device)
+
+    leaf = base.clone().requires_grad_(True)
+    ref_leaf = base.clone().requires_grad_(True)
+    logits = leaf.t() if transposed else leaf
+    ref_logits = ref_leaf.t() if transposed else ref_leaf
+    assert logits.is_contiguous() != transposed
+    out = logprobs_from_logits_v2(logits, labels)
+    ref = _per_row_logprobs(ref_logits, labels)
+    out.backward(grad_out)
+    ref.backward(grad_out)
+
+    assert out.dtype == ref.dtype == dtype
+    assert torch.equal(out.view(torch.int16), ref.view(torch.int16))
+    assert torch.equal(leaf.grad.view(torch.int16), ref_leaf.grad.view(torch.int16))
+
+
+def test_logprobs_from_logits_v2_bf16_2d_does_not_loop_over_tokens(monkeypatch):
+    calls = []
+    log_softmax = F.log_softmax
+
+    def counting_log_softmax(*args, **kwargs):
+        calls.append(args[0].shape)
+        return log_softmax(*args, **kwargs)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(torch_functional.F, "log_softmax", counting_log_softmax)
+    logits = torch.randn(64, 1000).to(torch.bfloat16)
+    labels = torch.randint(0, 1000, (64,))
+    assert logprobs_from_logits_v2(logits, labels).shape == (64,)
+    assert calls == [torch.Size([64, 1000])]

@@ -170,6 +170,9 @@ def logprobs_from_logits_naive(logits: torch.Tensor, labels: torch.Tensor) -> to
     return logpy
 
 
+_LOGPROB_CHUNK_BYTES = 1 << 25
+
+
 def logprobs_from_logits_v2(logits: torch.FloatTensor, labels: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
     """Memory-efficient log-probability computation using row-wise processing.
 
@@ -198,12 +201,25 @@ def logprobs_from_logits_v2(logits: torch.FloatTensor, labels: torch.Tensor) ->
         logprobs_labels = logits_labels - logsumexp_values  # log_softmax(x_i) = x_i - logsumexp(x)
     else:
         # logsumexp approach is unstable with bfloat16, fall back to slightly less efficent approach
-        logprobs_labels = []
-        for row_logits, row_labels in zip(logits, labels, strict=True):  # loop to reduce peak mem consumption
-            row_logprobs = F.log_softmax(row_logits, dim=-1)
-            row_logprobs_labels = row_logprobs.gather(dim=-1, index=row_labels.unsqueeze(-1)).squeeze(-1)
-            logprobs_labels.append(row_logprobs_labels)
-        logprobs_labels = torch.stack(logprobs_labels)
+        if logits.dim() == 2:
+            # (num_tokens, vocab) under remove-padding: process rows in chunks of at most _LOGPROB_CHUNK_BYTES
+            # instead of one log_softmax per token; split() keeps a single autograd node for the whole input.
+            if labels.shape != logits.shape[:-1]:
+                raise ValueError(f"labels shape {tuple(labels.shape)} does not match logits {tuple(logits.shape)}")
+            rows = max(1, _LOGPROB_CHUNK_BYTES // (logits.shape[-1] * logits.element_size()))
+            logprobs_labels = torch.cat(
+                [
+                    F.log_softmax(chunk, dim=-1).gather(dim=-1, index=chunk_labels.unsqueeze(-1)).squeeze(-1)
+                    for chunk, chunk_labels in zip(logits.split(rows), labels.split(rows), strict=True)
+                ]
+            )
+        else:
+            logprobs_labels = []
+            for row_logits, row_labels in zip(logits, labels, strict=True):  # loop to reduce peak mem consumption
+                row_logprobs = F.log_softmax(row_logits, dim=-1)
+                row_logprobs_labels = row_logprobs.gather(dim=-1, index=row_labels.unsqueeze(-1)).squeeze(-1)
+                logprobs_labels.append(row_logprobs_labels)
+            logprobs_labels = torch.stack(logprobs_labels)
     return logprobs_labels
